[이름 미확인] is normally a peaceful town where the Bellflowers reside...until recently, when the sinister [이름 미확인] invaded without warning! 구옹 screams for help, because the King of the Bellflowers, 우양, has been kidnapped. Make your way onto the pirates' battleship and find a way to remove [이름 미확인]. The goal of Stage 1 is to defeat all the monsters as quickly as possible. On Stage 2, the battle takes place on the deck. Make sure to find the hidden route onto the deck. For the final stage, defeat [이름 미확인] and rescue 우양! - Time Limit 1) Stage 1: 4 min 2) Stage 2: 6 min 3) Stage 3: 6 min + 6 min 4) Stage 4: 6 min 5) Stage 5: 8 min - Players: 3 - 6 - Rewards: #i01002571# 데비존의 모자 (Clear the Lord Pirate PQ 30 times to acquire it)

퀘스트 설명 (영문 원문)

When you went to go see the God of Mountains, he was deep in thought. According to him, a fox only becomes an evil Nine-Tailed Fox after a long period of training. Chil Nam seems to have been possessed by this Nine-Tailed Fox, but the God of Mountains cannot defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox with his current powers. So, he needs your help. The God of Mountains says the goblins in Black Mountain may know something about the Nine-Tailed Fox. Go see the goblins at the Goblin House near the Haunted House and find out how to defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox. In the meantime, the God of Mountains will find a way to break the Nine-Tailed Fox's spell.

후속 퀘스트

Cool as IceThe Fallen Warriors

퀘스트 설명 (영문 원문)

Jack Barricade has given me the Map of Phantom Forest that he took from Taggrin. He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square. Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use. Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin? If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, allowing me to use the marked shortcuts and save time traveling. But at the same time, there's a part of me that feels that this map still rightfully belongs to Taggrin. What should I do? It's a dilemma...
